headings.usage: All headings (h1-h6). Use font-light (300) for large display text to feel premium, and font-bold (700) for small labels.

body.usage: All body text, paragraphs, and inputs.

mono.usage: Data tables, code snippets, tenant IDs, API keys.

rules: NEVER use dark mode as default. This is a WHITE theme app.
Use 'Deep Obsidian' (#0A0A0A) for primary actions to create high contrast against white.
Use 'Silver/Slate' gradients for borders to add a metallic luxury feel.
Avoid generic 'SaaS Blue'. Use monochrome + texture.

textures.noise: Use a subtle SVG noise overlay at 2% opacity on the main background to prevent 'flatness'.

features: Customer reviews in a horizontal scrolling marquee (slow)
Cardless design or very subtle white cards on off-white bg
Exit mechanism: 5-sec long press on logo

buttons.primary: rounded-full bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:scale-105 transition-all shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl

cards.default: bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-100 shadow-soft p-6
cards.interactive: bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-100 shadow-soft hover:shadow-floating transition-all cursor-pointer

inputs.default: h-12 rounded-xl border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 focus:bg-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-black/5 transition-all

instructions_to_main_agent: UPDATE 'tailwind.config.js' to use the 'Outfit' and 'Manrope' fonts.
REMOVE 'Playfair Display' references. It is forbidden.
IMPLEMENT the 'God View' dashboard with a high-density data grid.
IMPLEMENT the 'Kiosk Mode' with the specific 5-second long-press exit logic.
ENSURE the 'Inventory Manager' supports image uploads (mocked if necessary).
USE the provided image URLs for the respective sections.
CREATE a 'Customer Reviews' section on the landing page with a horizontal marquee.
STRICTLY follow the White Luxury theme. No dark mode toggle.
universal_guidelines: Do not use generic centered layouts.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs (p-8, p-12).
Every interaction must have a micro-animation.
Do not use 'Inter' font for headings.
Do not use purple or teal for CTAs.
